name: ByteDance Seedance 2.5
role: B-roll without recognisable faces, scenes built from several reference images, long takes up to 30 s

pricing.note: Billed in video tokens. The estimate uses the formula above and is approximate; the ledger records the real cost.

gotchas: Rejects input images that may show a real person (InputImageSensitiveContentDetected). Use it for rooms, objects, hands, crowds from behind; use H3 for faces.
No memory between shots. Phrases like 'same position as before' mean nothing; restate the full blocking in every shot.
Words like add, remove, replace, extend, continue make it classify the job as an edit and fail with TaskTypeConstraint.
It copies the pose of the reference photo more than the sentence. If the object must lie flat, give a photo of it lying flat.
Cannot draw text or numbers: close-ups of screens, notebooks, calculators or forms come back as scribbles.
Acted laughter looks uncomfortable. Direct smiles, not laughs.
Each reference image must be at least 300 px per side with an aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.
